component.name: PatchDiff
component.summary: Watch game DLLs and see exactly what a patch changed

description.p: PatchDiff watches a compiled .NET assembly — typically a Unity game's Assembly-CSharp.dll — snapshots its decompiled source, and shows a side-by-side diff whenever the file changes.
Every detected patch is stored as a revision with its hash and assembly version, and an HTML report is written for each one. A headless CLI is included for scripted comparisons.
Diff Workbench interface, hardened file watcher, and a rebuilt release pipeline.
